Obtain the ROBOTIS original actuator STEP downloads from the published drawing pages.
Put the X430 assembly with horn and idler in this directory as X430.step.
Put the XC330 assembly in this directory as XC330.step. Other industry CAD formats and revision-specific topology may require adapting the two motor import routines.
